# musubi

> musubi binds the content one agent skill provides to the skills that follow it, and checks them again when that content changes.

## Definition

- [The musubi definition](https://musubi.cardene.dev/spec/): the normative English text, definition version 2026-11-19
- [musubiの定義](https://musubi.cardene.dev/ja/spec/): the Japanese translation
- [Source and README](https://github.com/cardene777/musubi): how to install the musubi command and list a skill

## Skills

- [contract-design (cardene777/agent-shuriken)](https://musubi.cardene.dev/skills/cardene777/agent-shuriken/contract-design/): Designs smart contracts before they are written, asking the decisions one at a time and writing one design document on how contracts are split, token standards, invariants, roles, upgrades, prices, transaction ordering, randomness, and external calls, from dated items. Use when designing contracts. follows design-doc/design ^1.0.0, design-doc/verify ^1.0.0
- [dapp-architecture (cardene777/agent-shuriken)](https://musubi.cardene.dev/skills/cardene777/agent-shuriken/dapp-architecture/): Designs how the parts of a dApp fit together, asking the decisions one at a time and writing one design document on who sends and pays for each transaction, indexing, data placement, environments, admin keys, and monitoring, from dated items on the services. Use when planning a dApp's architecture. follows design-doc/design ^1.0.0, design-doc/verify ^1.0.0
- [design-doc (cardene777/agent-shuriken)](https://musubi.cardene.dev/skills/cardene777/agent-shuriken/design-doc/): Holds the shared format of a design document and the verify script that checks one, for skills that write designs, such as the design skills of evm-dev. Use when another skill says to write in the design format of the design-doc skill or to run its verify. It writes no design on its own. provides design 1.0.0, verify 1.0.0
- [financial-standards (cardene777/agent-shuriken)](https://musubi.cardene.dev/skills/cardene777/agent-shuriken/financial-standards/): Designs apps with on-chain and off-chain parts built on financial standards such as ISO 20022, FIX, FpML, CDM, LEI, and XBRL, asking the decisions one at a time and writing one design document from dated items on each standard's version. Use when designing systems that carry financial standards. follows design-doc/design ^1.0.0, design-doc/verify ^1.0.0
- [multichain-design (cardene777/agent-shuriken)](https://musubi.cardene.dev/skills/cardene777/agent-shuriken/multichain-design/): Designs apps that run on more than one chain, asking the decisions one at a time and writing one design document on same-address deployment, moving assets, verifying cross-chain messages, and what happens when only one side completes, from dated items. Use when designing across chains. follows design-doc/design ^1.0.0, design-doc/verify ^1.0.0
- [wallet-design (cardene777/agent-shuriken)](https://musubi.cardene.dev/skills/cardene777/agent-shuriken/wallet-design/): Designs wallets and signing, asking the decisions one at a time and writing one design document on how keys are held and recovered, ERC-4337 and EIP-7702 accounts, signed permissions, approvals, who pays gas, and AI agent payments, from dated items. Use when designing wallets or signing. follows design-doc/design ^1.0.0, design-doc/verify ^1.0.0
